model: broader algebraic Kenyon-Smirnov realization class, without imposing source TE3

transformation.complementary_boundary_datum: gamma_i -> gamma_i / c_i so that beta_i gamma_i and the prescribed boundary edge increment remain fixed

preservation_proof.primitive_boundary_edge: Each boundary primitive increment contains k_Bi beta_i times the unchanged internal endpoint factor, so (k_Bi/c_i)(c_i beta_i)=k_Bi beta_i.
preservation_proof.interior_discrete_holomorphic_equations: At the internal endpoint incident to B_i, the only changed boundary contribution contains the same invariant product k_Bi beta_i.
preservation_proof.complementary_boundary_equation: The equation on the opposite discrete-holomorphic system contains k_Bi times the unchanged internal factor and the complementary boundary datum; both sides scale by 1/c_i.
preservation_proof.prescribed_boundary: beta_i gamma_i is invariant, so the boundary edge vector is unchanged.
preservation_proof.geometry: Every primitive increment is unchanged, hence the entire labeled embedding is unchanged.

source_TE3_effect: This symmetry generally changes the boundary-fixed weight gauge class and therefore does not preserve TE3 for a fixed weighted graph. That is exactly why it is an obstruction only in the broader algebraic-realization class.
exact_conclusion: Without TE3 or another independent boundary normalization, the primitive geometry cannot determine all boundary weight directions.
